[quote=astanir;60444962]It would soon become clear that the air assault could not be destroyed, nor held off by the argossians, so the tribal leaders would order the evacuation of major settlements. Civilians would be transported into the thick jungle in the southern portions of the island for safety, where they would hide in makeshift shelters, camouflaged by the leaves. The argossians would also request that Nordiheim use their armoured transport vehicles to help evacuate the civilians safely.

The UDF loitering munitions would silently hover above the snipers, before exploding just as the snipers realised what had happened. This would take out several unsuspecting snipers until new orders were issued. The drones would force the snipers even further into the Astaniran jungle, which would protect them from attacks from high above, but would also obscure their view and prevent the snipers from hitting any more UDF soldiers.

Napalm and clustering munitions would be no use against the snipers now hidden deep within the jungle. From high above, it would be hard to pinpoint the snipers location, but even if an accurate shot was taken, the several layers of trees, with spread out leaves would protect the snipers. If any got through the trees, by the time the napalm and munitions reached the ground, the snipers would be long gone, having seen the signs of an attack before any harm could be done, but they could only run away from the frontlines, allowing the UDF to continue advancing.

The poison gas shells would be the final blow to the argossians. As gas spread throughout the jungle, entire families would flee to escape the island. Soldiers became dizzy, stumbled and dropped dead en masse. This would create chaos as civilians tried to flee with no guidance, no assistance and no warning. Casualties would soar even as civilians escaped the jungle and reached the coastline, through trampling and drowning. Makeshift rafts and Nordiheimian-provided floats would help the tribespeople to escape, but where too? The entirety of Astanir had been engulfed in the flames of war and there are no nearby islands or landing places, save for the argos and shamat mainlands. Cries for help would be yelled across the ocean in hopes that the Nordiheimian navy would pick them up, but the population continued to drop by the second as the UDF slowly made their way across the islands
